name: Sketch words
description: Cut to warm paper with pencil guide lines. A small word writes itself by hand, then a big serif word is sketched letter by letter: pencil outlines first, then red hatching fills it. A pencil underline swipes under it. It all boils a little, like stop motion. The speaker stays in front.
when: When one word is the point: a name, a claim, a topic you want to land in a crafted way.
needs: the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
